result.notes: Previous pass ran zero searches (budget exhausted by siblings), so this run started from scratch and used the full 28-search cap. Output: 84 JSONL rows at /home/user/cladue/buyers_research/parts/D_market/D5_newmark_avison.jsonl; first version (47 rows) was written at the halfway point and overwritten at the end. Coverage: Newmark Northern/Central NJ fundamentals for 2Q21, 4Q21 (incl. 4Q20 comparison), 4Q22, 4Q23 (via national report table), Q3 2023 (via ROI-NJ), 2Q24, 3Q24, 4Q24; Avison Young NJ fundamentals for 3Q20 (incl. 3Q19), 4Q20 (incl. 4Q19), Q2 2021, Q3 2022, FY2023 (NNJ leasing, occupancy-at-delivery), Q1 2024 (availability 9.4%, NNN rent $16.12, deliveries, preleasing), mid-2024 sublease metrics, FY2024/Q4 2024/H1 2024 leasing, Q1 2025 leasing and rent change, and a 2025 sales-volume comparison figure. Buyer-type statistics were thin for these two firms: only IOS institutional-share (7-10%, national context) and qualitative buyer-pool statements were found; no Newmark/AY NJ cap-rate series or buyer-share breakdowns surfaced. Also captured adjacent market stats that appeared in the same press results (NAI DiLeo-Bram H1 2023: 111 trades, $1.386B, $265/SF +34%; ROI-NJ Q1 2025 $256/SF and #1 national rank; TRD Jan 2022 in-place/new-lease rents) with the originating firm noted so the join can route them. Custom metric names used where the vocabulary lacked a fit: asking_rent_growth_yoy, asking_rent_growth_ytd, asking_rent_growth_6yr, asking_rent_change_ytd, net_absorption_sf_ytd, occupancy_at_delivery, preleased_share_under_construction, sublease_availability_growth_ytd, sublease_space_added_sf, sublease_asking_rent_psf, in_place_rent_psf, broker_team_sales_volume, sales_volume_rank_national, ios_rent_growth_5yr, ios_rent_growth_cumulative, ios_vacancy_rate, ios_rent_per_acre_low/high. Rows whose attribution rests on a landing page or an ambiguous excerpt carry 'VERIFY' in notes (Newmark 4Q22 and 4Q24 rows, TRD 2022 rent rows, IOS vacancy row, Central NJ IOS rent-per-acre rows, AY $2.26B 2025 sales figure with unclear period basis). Two rows have blank year (undated re-nj cap-rate-below-3% statement; Fennelly IOS rent range) rather than a guessed date. Nothing was fabricated; excerpts with unclear geography (AY '$17B / 7.3% cap rate', '-2 MSF 2023 absorption / 5.8% vacancy' likely JLL, 2018 TRD sales figures, 2026-dated figures) were deliberately excluded.
